items.headline: BRICS Summit Adopts New Delhi Declaration Amid High-Level Diplomatic Talks
items.summary: World leaders adopted the New Delhi Declaration by consensus on September 12 during the 18th BRICS Summit in India. The meeting served as a prominent forum for global policy discussions and featured key diplomatic exchanges, including bilateral talks between Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

items.headline: Anthropic CEO Calls for Slowing Down AI Development Over Safety Risks
items.summary: Anthropic Chief Executive Dario Amodei published a proposal urging tech companies to slow the pace of frontier AI development to allow safety measures and oversight to catch up. The call gained widespread attention after rival leaders Sam Altman of OpenAI and Elon Musk of xAI publicly voiced agreement with the idea.

items.headline: Elena Rybakina Wins First US Open Title and Claims World No. 1 Ranking
items.summary: Kazakhstan's Elena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 to win her first US Open women's singles title on Saturday. The victory marks her second Grand Slam crown of 2026 and officially elevates her to the world number one ranking.

items.headline: Danish Drama 'Woman Unknown' Wins Golden Lion at Venice Film Festival
items.summary: Director May el-Toukhy's historical drama 'Woman Unknown' won the prestigious Golden Lion for Best Film at the 83rd Venice Film Festival on Saturday. The film's star, Mathilde Arcel, also captured the Volpi Cup for Best Actress after jury president Maggie Gyllenhaal and her team unanimously made an exception to award two major prizes to a single film.
